🩸 Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026 – Blood Grouping | Important Question Discussion | Principles of Inheritance and Variation | Kerala Class 12 Biology

Attention Kerala Plus Two Zoology students! Are you preparing for the upcoming Plus Two Christmas Exam 2026? Don't miss this important question discussion on Blood Grouping, a key concept from the chapter Principles of Inheritance and Variation! 💯

In this RK Nex Plus Two session, we explain the inheritance of human blood groups, the ABO blood grouping system, multiple allelism, codominance, and important genotype-based questions through simple and easy-to-remember methods.

Learn how different combinations of alleles determine human blood groups, understand the relationship between genotypes and phenotypes, and revise important NCERT-based Genetics concepts.

This session is designed to help Kerala Plus Two students strengthen their conceptual understanding, solve genetic cross questions, and prepare confidently for the Christmas Examination 2026.

📌 In This Video:

✅ Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026
✅ Blood Grouping – Important Question Discussion
✅ Principles of Inheritance and Variation
✅ ABO Blood Grouping System
✅ Inheritance of Human Blood Groups
✅ Multiple Allelism
✅ Codominance – Important Concepts
✅ Dominant and Recessive Alleles
✅ Iᴬ, Iᴮ and i Alleles
✅ Blood Group A – Possible Genotypes
✅ Blood Group B – Possible Genotypes
✅ Blood Group AB – Codominance
✅ Blood Group O – Recessive Inheritance
✅ Six Genotypes and Four Phenotypes
✅ Blood Group Inheritance Patterns
✅ Punnett Square Method
✅ Blood Group-Based Genetic Crosses
✅ Important NCERT-Based Zoology Questions
✅ Application-Level Genetics Questions
✅ Christmas Exam Quick Revision

🎯 Why Watch This Video?

The ABO Blood Grouping System is a classic example of both multiple allelism and codominance in human genetics.

The ABO blood group is controlled by three alleles: Iᴬ, Iᴮ and i. Both Iᴬ and Iᴮ are dominant over i, while Iᴬ and Iᴮ are codominant with each other.

The combination of these alleles produces six possible genotypes and four blood group phenotypes: A, B, AB and O.

Understanding these inheritance patterns helps students solve genetic crosses, identify possible blood groups of offspring, and answer important application-level examination questions.

This session simplifies these concepts through clear explanations and easy learning techniques, helping students revise effectively for the Plus Two Christmas Exam 2026 and Plus Two Public Exam 2027.

💯 Understand Blood Group Inheritance. Master Genetic Crosses. Aim for A+!
